about: The outsider round's questions (2026-10-13), as the three outsiders worded them — the eight seed questions, then each outsider's numbered questions to the guide, the first sentence of each, verbatim apart from the application's and its company's names. Each names the shape Ask must read it as on the examples/invoice-app fixture graph and, where the fixture holds the thing, the part it must pick. `outside` marks a question no shape of a grammar over code can answer (who holds a role in production, what a word means to the business); Ask must answer those with did you mean, never a guess.

questions.q: Who is allowed to approve an invoice?
What is required to approve an invoice?
Can you configure what is required on an invoice?
How do you configure the invoice requirements?
How does a vendor get approved?
How do we know the vendor account is for who they say it is for?
What happens to an invoice the operator sends back for correction, and what does the contractor see?
When does the business actually pay, and where is the payment recorded?
Which roles can do which operator actions?
Can a reviewer approve an invoice?
Four-eyes scope: does four-eyes apply to every invoice, or only ones an operator keyed in (image/email)?
questions.outside: a question about a check's scope across records: answered by the check's gate card, not a shape

questions.q: Which action makes an invoice Paid?
Can an invoice be rejected or cancelled at all today?
During a correction, what status does the invoice show, and what does the contractor see in the built app today?
questions.outside: the status a persona sees during a correction is a lifecycle view the app declares, not a shape

questions.q: Is "Approve as a new vendor" built and working?
Who performs "Attach the engagement to an identity that already exists"?
What exactly does the operator compare in the duplicate-vendor match, and is the W-9 request something the app does or a manual step outside it?
What can a client configure, where, and who does it?
Who is the "client"?
questions.outside: who a party is in the business is not in the code

questions.q: What happens to an invoice whose BC post fails terminally?
Do users see the status names drawn here?
questions.outside: the words a persona sees are a lifecycle view the app declares, not a shape

questions.q: When is "the week" cut off for the weekly cycle, and who closes it: any approver, or one named person?
Can a contractor have several vendor accounts, and a vendor several contacts?
questions.outside: a question about the data model's cardinality: the code map's record cards answer it, not a shape

questions.q: When a new subcontractor creates an account, does a vendor record land in Business Central before anyone on my team has approved it?
What exactly does my team compare in the "duplicate-vendor match" — name, address, tax ID, bank account?
Bank details and W-9: who enters the subcontractor's bank account, where (in Business Central?), and does anything in this app check that the bank account was verified before money moves?
Can a person with only the reviewer role press "Approve" on an invoice, or "Approve as a new vendor"?
Four-eyes: does it apply to invoices the subcontractor uploads, or only to ones my office keys in?
questions.outside: a question about a check's scope across records: answered by the check's gate card, not a shape

questions.q: Are there any amount-based approval limits or a second approver above a threshold?
Duplicate invoices: what stops the same invoice being submitted twice — same invoice number, same amount, same vendor, a resubmission under a second vendor account?

Bad path — wrong amount: if my reviewer thinks the amount is wrong, what can they do today (edit it themselves? send it back?) and what does the subcontractor see, given the "action needed" page isn't built?
questions.outside: a what-can-I-do question over a screen: the screen's actions on the Map answer it, not a shape

questions.q: Bad path — rejection: can an invoice be rejected/denied at all today?
When does money actually leave, and who moves it?
questions.outside: money leaving through a partner outside the platform is not in the code

questions.q: Which action marks an invoice Paid — "Record the payment intent" or a separate "Mark paid"?
What can my company configure without the vendor's developers: required documents per program, required fields, approval rules, roles?
Who is the "client" whose approval is in "Pending client approval", and who receives the consolidated weekly invoice?
questions.outside: who a party is in the business is not in the code

questions.q: Audit: when an admin overrides four-eyes, or my team approves a pending identity link, where is that recorded and can I pull a report for my auditors?
questions.outside: a reporting question: no shape names a report

questions.q: Of what I've seen, what is live for a real customer today versus this one POC campaign?
questions.outside: what runs in production is not in the code

questions.q: Who may approve an invoice, and which test proves that a reviewer — not an approver — is refused?
Which action actually makes an invoice "Paid"?
Where is the money sent from, by whom, and who pays the consolidated client invoice?
questions.outside: money moved by a partner outside the platform is not in the code

questions.q: What happens to approval and to payouts if Business Central is unavailable for a day?
questions.outside: an outage is not a status the code declares

questions.q: Was the end-to-end payment case ever run to completion?
Can one person create a vendor and then approve invoices to it?
The admin override of four-eyes: who holds "admin", how many people, and where is the override reason reviewed?
questions.outside: who holds a role in production is not in the code

questions.q: Which of today's flows is in production with real money, and which is the "POC"?
